test_objective: Check that you cannot create a subscription with an invalid/empty id

test_cases.name: 028_03_01 InvalidId
test_cases.doc: Check that you cannot create a subscription with an invalid/empty id
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/subscriptions/'
        method set to 'POST'
        Request Header['Content-Type'] set to 'application/ld+json' and
 payload defined in file: 'subscriptions/subscription-sample.jsonld'
}
